note: Declared colour-token pairs checked against the real src/styles/tokens.css by verify-source and by the contrast test. Body text needs 4.5:1, focus rings need 3:1 against each adjacent surface (WCAG 2.2 AA). Only pairs that components actually use are declared; a failing pair is reported, never adjusted here (Req 4.5 governs token changes).
